generate_proto_bindings: generate Python protobuf bindings for alphagenome protos using the GenerateProtos Hatch build hook
build_proto_python_out: build Python code from proto files by running protoc with --python_out to the src directory
build_proto_grpc_python_out: build gRPC Python stubs from proto files by running protoc with --grpc_python_out to the src directory
review_GenerateProtos_initialize: review the GenerateProtos class initialize method that compiles proto files via grpc_tools.protoc
refactor_ALPHAGENOME_PROTOS: refactor the _ALPHAGENOME_PROTOS tuple to add or remove proto file paths for binding generation
